verdict.rationale: Admin-level governance of AI agents is a fair question for a Git forge, but the evidence shows no way to enable or disable agents per group or instance, and no allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. What it does document is adjacent and earns no credit: an individual user can scope their own MCP connection to all or selected repositories, and agents need the user's approval to write to issues and pull requests. That is per-user OAuth consent, not organization or instance tool policy.
